observations: Three photos show a silver JVC Everio camcorder from different angles.
The brand 'JVC' and model line 'Everio' are visible on the body in all photos.
The label 'HD' is present, indicating high-definition capability.
A sticker shows '20x Optical Zoom' and 'Dual Memory' features.
The camera body shows signs of wear, including scratches and smudges.
No screen, lens cap, or memory card is visible in the photos.
No power or function test is shown; no video or audio output is demonstrated.

claims.claim: JVC HD video camera for livestream and video recording
claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, and 2 show a JVC Everio HD camcorder, which is designed for video recording. Livestream capability is unverified but plausible for this type of device.
The 'Dual Memory' sticker is visible in all photos, suggesting support for external memory, but no memory card slot or card is shown. No proof of functionality.

risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera turning on, recording, and playing back footage.

risks.risk: The lens or internal components may be damaged or dirty, affecting video quality.
risks.proof: A close-up of the lens and a video sample showing the recorded image quality.

risks.risk: The memory card slot may be non-functional or missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the memory card slot open and a card inserted, or a video showing data being written to a card.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lacking external memory support

proof_requests: Video clip showing the camera powering on and recording a short clip.
Close-up photo of the lens and memory card slot.
Photo of the camera with a memory card inserted and the screen displaying recorded footage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a JVC Everio HD camcorder, but critical functional claims (power, recording, memory card use) are unproven. Without proof of operation, it cannot be priced reliably. The photos show wear but no evidence of damage or functionality.
